source_zh: 四气调神大论 · 一、春养生
source_en: Siqi Tiaoshen Dalun · I. Nurturing Life in Spring
original: 春三月，此谓**发陈**，天地俱生，万物以荣。夜卧早起，广步于庭……生而勿杀，**予而勿夺**。
vernacular_zh: 春天万物生发，晚睡早起，在庭院里缓步；心志要生发：只生不杀，只给予不夺取。
translation_en: The three months of spring are called "issuing forth." Heaven and earth come to life together, and all things flourish. Go to bed late and rise early; stroll in the courtyard... Give life and do not kill; **give and do not take away.**

scripture.text_en:
...remember the words of the Lord Jesus,
how he said, It is **more blessed to give**
than to receive.

insight_zh: 岐伯：春主生，**予而勿夺**；耶稣：**施比受**更为有福。
insight_en: Qibo: in spring, **give and do not take**; Jesus: it is **more blessed to give** than to receive.
